label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Rick, I need you to actually read this whole thing and not just send me a thumbs up.

I'm really mad about the Gary thing. Not at Gary, he's allowed to pick whoever he wants. I'm mad at you. You told him I'd list his house for 1% without ever asking me. 1%, Rick. My listing side is 2.5%. I've never quoted 1% to anyone in my life, and you just threw that number out like it was nothing.

I gave up my whole Saturday for it. Pulled comps, drove down from north Phoenix to Chandler, did the walkthrough, put together a full listing packet. That's about 6 hours plus the drive. Then Sunday night he texts me that he's going with ListLite for $3,995, no hard feelings. When I called you, all I got was "that's business sis, can't win em all." No, that wasn't business. That was you making a promise with my time and my money and then leaving me to deal with it.

It's the same thing that happened with your softball guy two years ago. I let it go then. I'm not letting it go this time. You get to look like the guy who knows people, and I end up doing the work for free.

So this is how it's going to be from now on:
Don't give my number to anybody unless you ask me first. Every single time.
Don't quote my commission to anyone. Ever. You don't know what I charge and you don't get to set it.

About Denise, I'm not calling her. You gave her my cell without asking, so you can be the one to tell her I'm not available to pick my brain about her rental. If she wants to hire an agent, she can reach out like a normal client and I'll decide whether I take it.

To be clear, if it's actual family, like Mom or your kids, I'm always going to help, no charge, any time. That isn't going to change. But your buddies, coworkers and softball team aren't family, and I'm not your free perk to hand out.

I love you and I'll still be at your place for Thanksgiving. I just need you to hear me on this one. Please don't make me have this conversation again.
